question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：巴拿马 vs 克罗地亚（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Panama vs Croatia (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: 克罗地亚凭 182 分 Elo 优势与完整主力明显占优，但巴拿马状态佳且坐拥多伦多准主场，爆冷概率不可忽视。
one_liner_en: Croatia's 182-point Elo edge and full-strength squad make them clear favourites, but in-form Panama with a quasi-home Toronto crowd keep upset chances non-trivial.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 182 分（克罗地亚 1912 / 世界第 12 vs 巴拿马 1730 / 第 38），统计模型给出克罗地亚约 57% 胜率基线。
key_reasons.en: A 182-point Elo gap (Croatia 1912, world No. 12 vs Panama 1730, No. 38) yields a ~57% statistical baseline win probability for Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: 克罗地亚主力齐整：莫德里奇颧骨骨折后伤愈出战第五届世界杯，格瓦迪奥尔 5 月 14 日已复出。
key_reasons.en: Croatia at full strength: Modric fit for his fifth World Cup after a cheekbone fracture, and Gvardiol returned to action on May 14.

key_reasons.cn: 巴拿马近期状态佳（2025 国联决赛、最近 2-1 胜南非），且前两轮均在多伦多进行，准主场与赛程便利构成小幅上调依据。
key_reasons.en: Panama arrive in form (2025 Nations League finalists, beat South Africa 2-1 most recently) and play both opening matches in Toronto, a quasi-home and scheduling edge justifying a small upgrade.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 19.9/23.5/56.7; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2.2pp net from Croatia toward Panama/draw (cap ±8pp), renormalized. No betting odds or prediction-market data used.
